subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core cross-session run-progress observation API for `sessions_send`, and should the agent-facing surface be a new `sessions_subscribe` tool or an explicit `sessions_send` progress mode?
rationale: This would define a new security-sensitive session/event contract, including observer authorization, redaction, buffering, replay, retention, and Telegram/channel delivery semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design a core progress contract
options.body: Approve a scoped `agent.events` or equivalent run-event observation API plus an agent-facing tool/mode with explicit authorization, redaction, replay, and delivery rules.

options.title: Narrow to status-only delivery
options.body: Keep progress streaming deferred and only refine `sessions_send` accepted/timeout/final announce semantics for now.

options.title: Fold into broader process events
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826 the canonical design venue and keep this issue as a sessions_send consumer requirement.

recommendation.title: Design a core progress contract
recommendation.body: Approve a scoped `agent.events` or equivalent run-event observation API plus an agent-facing tool/mode with explicit authorization, redaction, replay, and delivery rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history on sessions_send, A2A delivery, ACP session behavior, and structured agent event surfaces.
